newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin rises on London's gains and more demand.
newsitem.headline: KL tin rises on London's gains and more demand.

text.p: Tin price rose four cents to close at 15 ringgit ($5.95) a kg after a higher London market encouraged buying from overseas, traders said.
"The market held steady. People are buying because of rallies in London," a trader said, adding that buying was mainly from Europe, Japan and local interest.
Turnover rose to 122 tonnes from 116 on Friday.
The local price differential over London was at par, after holding at a discount of $65 a tonne on Friday.
